items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: our first big break was the Cotton Club on Lenox Avenue, which was owned by (inaudible) Mike [Bass], Herman Steeks.

ctx.x: Now, what year -- you got to Cleveland in 1929?

Well, yeah, around 1929. I stayed there between Cleveland, Cincinnati and the territories around in there, and I -- we stayed around in that vicinity and finally wound up in Buffalo, New York. I stayed in Buffalo from 1933 --'32 or '33, and then we finally came to New York. Then our first big break was the Cotton Club on Lenox Avenue, which was owned by (inaudible) Mike [Bass], Herman Steeks. I'm going into detail. Now, they can erase it if they wish.
